name: Medication request packet
document: a made-up patient's medication request packet (it may be a fax, a scan or a phone photo, and may be handwritten)

fields.label: Patient
fields.note: the patient this page is about, as written

fields.label: Insurance member ID
fields.note: the member, subscriber or policy number, not the group number

fields.label: Diagnosis code
fields.note: the code of the diagnosis being treated, not other conditions

fields.label: Requested drug
fields.note: the newly requested or ordered drug, name only, no dose

fields.label: Strength
fields.note: the dose of the newly requested drug, like 10 mg

fields.label: Quantity
fields.note: the number to dispense on the order form

readers.name: Whole page
readers.instruction: Prior treatments are medications that were tried and stopped; never list current or unrelated medications there. Leave a date or result null if the page doesn't give it.

readers.name: Identity
readers.instruction: Read only who this page is about and their identifiers, if it has them.

readers.name: Order
readers.instruction: Read only the new request or order, if this page has one.

readers.name: History
readers.instruction: Read only medications that were tried and stopped, if this page has them; never list current or unrelated medications. Leave a date or result null if the page doesn't give it.

checks.message: the plan needs 2 prior treatments with start, stop and result
